title: L2 R2 corrective — trusted source metadata and coherent browser Wazuh ATT&CK cohorts
goal: Resolve two material reproducible R2 findings from independent L2 of E10-INV-120B-MITRE on frozen PR #187 without reimplementing the authorized Wazuh Case/Timeline workflow: reject explicit null/mistyped source metadata before the existing auth-limited receipt; reject browser technique counters/IDs inconsistent with source-authorized imported alert cohort.
invariants: Frozen #187 HEAD 53544c2a65f66324d004d48427b07493f7ac2d9e is never modified; this downstream branch is only a candidate delta against that reviewed Git SHA.
Only independently authorized existing Case, Timeline and Wazuh typed-source owner data reaches the same receipt; no change to owner, tenant, environment, permission or new route.
Missing Wazuh MITRE object/id is allowed as unknown; explicitly JSON null or malformed mitre/id cannot masquerade as untagged data and must fail without any receipt.
Browser displays at most 10 distinct source-defined techniques, sorted descending occurrence count and ascending ID for ties. Distinct IDs may exceed top-ten count only when top-ten is full.
An alert may carry 1..16 distinct techniques; counts across technique IDs overlap, so do not require the sum of all top-tag counts to equal number of authorized alerts.
Browser cannot trust server responses with duplicate labels, impossible non-mapped counts, invalid sorting, or truncated/incomplete top 10; reject atomically with no partial source display.
Existing operator-provided local Wazuh file size/alert caps, strict source IDs, no raw source leaks and prior IPC/HTTP authorization remain unchanged.
security_properties: Technique labels are source assertions and never proof of MITRE activity, detection accuracy, tenant role, evidence, or analyst authorization.
Fail closed on malformed/null source input before writing the Wazuh triage receipt, and fail closed in browser before modifying DOM.
No third-party dependencies, paid APIs, change to IAM, persistence, audit, host source, mutation or production exposure.

migration.rationale: Existing JSON fields and authorized read-only API remain identical; stricter validation only.

rollback.strategy: Revert the narrow delta; preserve unchanged frozen #187 baseline and all upstream Git history.
verification: No new path to source data
Earlier Wazuh positive and denial tests continue passing

inputs: Independent L2 of PR #187 SHA 53544c2a65f66324d004d48427b07493f7ac2d9e reported R2-01 browser source aggregate coherence and R2-02 explicit null source metadata treated as absent
Existing E10-INV-120B-MITRE IMPLEMENTED/CI green on same frozen SHA; technical L2 acceptable with R2 reservations
outputs: Authorized local Case/Timeline Wazuh metadata parser refuses explicit null or malformed MITRE objects/ID lists, while optional missing metadata yields an unmapped alert.
Existing local analyst browser rejects unique-ID, deterministic sort, top-ten completeness, unmapped count, mapped-count upper bounds and overlapping tag-count contradictions.
Tests derive from formerly accepted defective input, preserving valid overlapping tag counts and valid missing metadata.
One bounded 5000-alert × 16-label Go parsing stress test at existing source cap; no arbitrary latency threshold or production benchmark claim.
acceptance_tests: Go Case/Timeline disk import rejects raw id null, mitre null, wrong scalar/object metadata, without a receipt or raw leakage.
Missing mitre data still returns untagged source diagnostic and does not invent a source technique.
Node analyst view rejects repeated IDs even when count differs, order/tie anomalies, nonexistent top-ten entries, impossible mapped alert vs tag counts and extra source metadata.
Node analyst view accepts legitimate multiple source labels on one alert, whose count sum can exceed imported alert count.
Existing Linux race, Go coverage+vet, Node UI and platform CI pass at exact HEAD, engineering mandatory security checks unchanged.
definition_of_ready: CAP-INV-110 Class-0 local timeline read is defined; OPEN-013 excludes mutations.
Frozen audited #187 bug scenarios are reproducible from source and Go/Node test harness.
Existing 120B implementation is present; no new producer or domain redesign.
definition_of_done: Both originally reproducible R2 findings closed by negative and positive regressions on an exact new GitHub SHA
Relevant exact SHA CI PASS and no mandatory checks waived
Complete GitHub provenance and handoff; no claim of merged, native-approved or production CAP-INV-110 acceptance.

performance_budget.rationale: Go source parsing still bounded to at most 5000 alerts with 16 technique labels each; includes a deterministic limit-scale test but not a production latency assertion.
